svg.aria-label: Each phase ships only when it beats the layer below
svg.text: Each phase ships only when it beats the layer below
Roadmap: six phases, each closed by an exit gate

g.text: Phase 0 · Evidence and evaluation (build first)
Parsers for Claude Code JSONL and the claude.ai ZIP · secret scrubber · hybrid search
search_evidence + open_evidence over a local stdio MCP · 50–100 evaluation questions
Gate: beats Claude's built-in conversation search on the evaluation set
Phase 1 · Claims and review
Haiku 5.5 batch extraction with the origin taxonomy and valid-time resolution
Injected-context stripping · auto-accept policy · vault writer with git commits · CLI review
Gate: write precision of 80% or more on a sampled audit; zero AI-suggested claims auto-accepted
Packaging · Install in one command
brain init wizard: database, embedding model, exclusions, MCP client registration · brain doctor
brain daemon on Linux, macOS, Windows · npm package · Claude Code plugin · CI matrix
Gate: a fresh Linux or macOS machine reaches a searchable brain with brain init in under 15 minutes
Phase 2 · Serve everywhere
VPS deployment behind Nginx · single-user OAuth · claude.ai custom connector
SessionStart briefing hook · Zed context_servers configuration
Gate: brief and recall work on claude.ai mobile, Claude Code and Zed; scores hold with injection
Phase 3 · Supersession and decisions
Nightly Sonnet pass proposing supersedes and contradicts edges
Decision records with revisit_on reminders · MCP App review widget · eval on every ingest
Gate: inbox of 10 items a day or fewer; supersession questions clearly beat raw search
Phase 4 · Widen (optional)
Web UI: audit log, timeline and brain map · ChatGPT and Gemini importers
autoMemoryDirectory unification · forget-cascade UI · driven by actual use
